name: @iiwate/pi-silent-gui
description: Pi extension: start, screenshot, and drive a GUI on a private Windows desktop

scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-reporter=dot tests/unit/protocol.test.mjs && python -m unittest -q tests.unit.test_audio tests.unit.test_broker tests.unit.test_capture tests.unit.test_common tests.unit.test_desktop tests.unit.test_window tests.unit.test_process tests.unit.test_silent_gui tests.unit.test_inject
scripts.test:integration: python -m unittest -q tests.integration.test_backend_cli tests.integration.test_broker_failures && node --test --test-reporter=dot tests/integration/extension.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run --silent test:unit && npm run --silent test:integration && npm run --silent test:smoke
